cluster_canonical_S10.note: Kish is a concentration diagnostic, not an estimate of serial dependence and not the definitive effective sample size of returns. The rho series is the frozen formula using the arithmetic mean non-empty cluster size; the exact Kish value uses the size-weighted mean and is reported separately.

sensitivity_4h_exemption.note: Reruns the candidate with the twelve registered gap-adjacent 4h buckets marked unusable and the 4h ATR segment-broken at them. It is reported for transparency only and never changes the primary signal set, denominator, or verdict.

concentration.note: Pre-declared descriptive screening criterion, not a statistical test and not a dependence estimate.

verdict.frozen_tier_meaning: Tier label from the frozen candidate specification, reported separately. Neither tier nor PASS is evidence of profitability.
verdict.precedence: INCONCLUSIVE, then INSUFFICIENT OPPORTUNITIES, then EXCESSIVE CONCENTRATION, then FEASIBILITY PASS
